instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The number of people inhabiting our planet has constantly increased over the last decades. From 1990 to 2020 the Earth’s population increased by <mat>30%</mat>.

atoms.a: What decimal number represents the increase in population?
Now select the fraction that represents the increase in population.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: People moving from the countryside to metropolitan areas is one reason for the rapid growth of cities. For example, the population of San Francisco has grown by a rate of 0.8 since the 1950s.

atoms.a: What fraction represents the growth rate?
Now select the percentage that represents the growth rate.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: In 1950, about 50.4 million people lived in the UK. <mat>80%</mat> of the nation’s population lived in cities.

atoms.a: What two fractions represent the amount of people that lived in cities?
Now select the decimal number that represents the amount of people that lived in cities.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: According to recent research, the number of people moving to urban spaces will increase even more over the next decades. City planners predict that <mat>62%</mat> of US citizens will live in cities with more than 2 million people, and a further <mat>13%</mat> will live in cities with more than 1 million people.

atoms.a: What decimal number represents the amount of people living in cities with more than two million citizens.
Now select the fraction that represents the amount of people living in cities with more than two million citizens.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The most populated city in the world is Tokyo, with more than 36 million people. However, researchers estimate that Tokyo’s population will soon begin to decline. They estimate that in the year 2100, only <mat>21/50</mat> of the current population will live in Tokyo.
atoms.sound: The most populated city in the world is Tokyo Japan, with more than 36 million people. However, researchers estimate that Tokyo’s population will soon begin to decline. They estimate that in the year 2100, only <mat>21/50</mat> of the current population will live in Tokyo.

atoms.a: What percentage represents the estimated amount of people living in Tokyo?
Now select the decimal number that represents the estimated amount of people living in Tokyo.
